Standard: All stores are capable of being uploaded, downloaded, and handled under all operating conditions without damaging the air system. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Examination.
(1) Verify that store loading and installation procedures are documented and support loading and handling of stores without degrading accessibility IAW MIL-STD-1289, Accessibility section to other air systems or inhibiting crewmember egress in the event of an emergency.
(2) Verify that store technical documentation covers all upload and download procedures, store maintenance and troubleshooting procedures, weapon station checks, installation of arming lanyards and clips, and removal of safing pins.
(3) Verify that ground support equipment required for loading and weapon station checks have been evaluated for compatibility IAW MIL-HDBK-1763, Test 101 and Test 102, without compromising the AW of the air system. Demonstration.
  (1) Verify through demonstration that stores can be uploaded and downloaded under all operating conditions while maintaining clearances with the air vehicle and any adjacent stores IAW MIL-HDBK-1763, Test 101 and Test 102, without compromising the AW of the air system.
